title: Bolli's Leather Supplies
source: camelot.allakhazam.com/quests.html?cquest=325 (retold in our own words; the page gives 40 and 80 experience for the two stages, about 6 silver, and the Choker of the Bear, which we pay once at the end; levels 3 to 50)
offer: A huldu lurker made off with my skinning knife, and I cannot work without it. Fetch it back, and I may have more work for you after.
complete: Fine bones. That is all I needed. Take this for your trouble.

steps.text: Kill huldu lurkers on the hills west of Mularn for Bolli's skinning knife.
Bring the skinning knife back to Bolli.
steps.say: My knife! Now, I will need a bone as well.

steps.text: Take a shinbone from a rattling skeleton outside Mularn.
